cdWindowDim - Requirements

cdWindowDim works with all versions of Clarion:

  • Clarion 12
  • Clarion 11.x
  • Clarion 10
  • Clarion 9.x
  • Clarion 8
  • Clarion 7
  • Clarion 6
  • Clarion 5.5

cdWindowDim works with both template chains:

  • ABC Template Chain
  • Legacy Clarion Template Chain

Both AppGen and hand-coded applications are supported.

cdWindowDim works with both single EXE and multi-DLL applications.

Window Dimming manifest requirement

Applications using Window Dimming must include a Windows 8-or-later compatibility manifest in the EXE, or the visual overlay may not appear. See Window Dimming Troubleshooting.

Automatic message dimming is enabled by default for standard Clarion messages and supported CapeSoft MessageBox windows. For other message windows, use the optional Custom Message Window extension.
